steps.description: Import `numpy as np` and call `np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True)` so floating-point arrays display up to 4 decimal places with small scientific-notation values suppressed.

Notice the two keyword arguments on line 2: `precision=4` rounds displayed array entries to 4 decimal digits, and `suppress=True` formats small floats in fixed-point notation.
